description: This file contains test routines for checking protocol disabling in Git, including functions for testing environment variable configurations, Git config settings, and cloning with different protocols. It also includes setup procedures for SSH and remote wrappers used in testing.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests Git operations with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable set to various values, including enabled and disabled scenarios.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests Git clone, fetch, and push operations with protocol.allow configuration settings and environment variables.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs combined tests for a specific protocol, invoking test_allow_var and test_config functions.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper script used in testing remote SSH connections.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper script for remote-ext testing of repositories within a trash directory.
